scripts.build: pnpm --filter @lab-app/shared build --if-present && pnpm --filter @lab-app/api build && pnpm --filter @lab-app/web build
scripts.db:push: cd apps/api && npx prisma db push --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:generate: cd apps/api && npx prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.postinstall: cd apps/api && npx prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.prisma
